docs.title: Overview
docs.text: In addition to access logs from web console, Splashtop log events can also be sent to a Syslog server or SIEM tool that support Syslog in your local environment. The auditing of Splashtop event logs can be accessed both from Gateway web console, download as CSV or Syslog collectors simultaneously.

docs.title: 1. Configuration
docs.text:
1. To configure Splashtop Gateway as Syslog source, log in web console as Team Owner, go to Settings → Syslog.

  2. You can configure Gateway to send Syslog messages up to two Syslog servers.

  3. Click add to configure your target Syslog server.

  4. Syslog Settings

NameSyslog host name in Splashtop Gateway. Syslog Server addressEnter the hostname or IP address of the syslog server receiving log messages. PortSyslog over UDP defaults to use port 514. The defaults can be changed. Syslog ProtocolSupports UDP or TCP. Message FormatSupports RFC 5424 or RFC 3164 (BSD). FacilityChoose proper facility from local0 - local7. SeverityChoose the proper Syslog severity. StatusOnce enabled, Splashtop Gateway starts to send persistent syslog messages to your Syslog Server. Test MessageSend a message to your Syslog Server to test the above settings.

docs.title: 3. Syslog message examples
docs.text:
Splashtop syslog message examples following standard RFC 5424 format are showing below.

Example 1.

05-13-2022 14:44:54 Local0.Notice 192.168.70.75 1 2022-05-13T14:44:54+05:00 Test-Vistro onpremise.exe 3292 SOP - timestamp=2022-05-13T09:44:54Z;team_id=1;event_id=team_file_transfer_enabled;account=john.doe@example.com;agent=browser;source_address=192.168.67.22;source_name=IE;source_version=110.0.1587;source_os=Windows;category=management;kind=team_mgmt;action=update;result=success;target=remote_support_setting;desc:file_transfer=enabled;

The example indicates event of enabling file transfer function from Team Settings was occurred at a given time by what account with specific IP address and device information.

Example 2.

Below syslog messages were generated by a login attempt to Splashtop web console resulted in failure (2) because a privileged account has enabled browser authentication in an earlier time (1). docs.title: Events and triggers
docs.text: Event Trigger login A user has attempted to log in to the Splashtop Gateway from the Business app or the web console. The result is success when the login has been completed, or failure when the login has been rejected; the reason of a failed login is recorded in the extra_result field. logout A user has logged out from the web console.

docs.title: Fields
docs.text: Field Value Explanation target String The user account that attempted to log in or log out. method1 ad or local or sso The primary authentication method of the login: an AD account, a local account, or an SSO account. method2 2fa_passcode or 2fa_recovery_code The secondary authentication method of the login when two-factor authentication is in use: a 2FA passcode or a 2FA recovery code. This field is present only when the login has reached the 2FA step. extra_result String The reason of a failed login. See the table below. This field is present only when the result is failure.

docs.text: Field Value Explanation target String The name of the target syslog server. FQDN String The address (FQDN) of the added syslog server.

docs.title: Events and triggers
docs.text: Event Trigger ssl_cert_imported An SSL certificate has been imported to the Gateway. ssl_cert_removed The SSL certificate has been removed from the Gateway. tls_setting_updated The TLS version setting of the Gateway has been updated. web_ip_restriction_enabled The IP restriction for web console access has been enabled. web_ip_restriction_disabled The IP restriction for web console access has been disabled. web_ip_restriction_ip_updated The allowed IP ranges for web console access have been updated. web_ip_restriction_access_deny_updated The response displayed when the web console is accessed from an IP address without permission has been updated. web_ip_restriction_allow_access_download_updated Allowing access to the support session app download pages (SOS, Service Desk, PIN Code) from all IP ranges has been enabled or disabled. client_ip_restriction_enabled The IP restriction for On-Prem app (Business app and streamer) access has been enabled. client_ip_restriction_disabled The IP restriction for On-Prem app (Business app and streamer) access has been disabled. client_ip_restriction_ip_updated The allowed IP ranges for On-Prem app access have been updated. openapi_ip_restriction_enabled The IP restriction for Open API access has been enabled. openapi_ip_restriction_disabled The IP restriction for Open API access has been disabled. openapi_ip_restriction_ip_updated The allowed IP ranges for Open API access have been updated.

docs.title: Fields
docs.text: Field Value Explanation old_tls 1.0 or 1.1+ or 1.2+ The previous minimum TLS version. new_tls 1.0 or 1.1+ or 1.2+ The updated minimum TLS version. old_access_deny HTTP 404 or Access forbidden The previous response displayed for an access without permission. new_access_deny HTTP 404 or Access forbidden The updated response displayed for an access without permission. status enabled or disabled Whether access to the support session app download pages from all IP ranges is allowed. IPs String The updated allowed IP ranges, separated by commas.

docs.title: Events and triggers
docs.text: Event Trigger certificate_installed_web A new certificate for an FQDN has been installed via the web console. certificate_installed_acme A new certificate for an FQDN has been installed via ACME, either requested by a user from the web console or renewed automatically by the system. certificate_installed_cli A new certificate for an FQDN has been installed via the CLI. acme_renewal_failed A certificate request via ACME for an FQDN has failed. The result of this event is failed. certificate_removed The certificate for an FQDN has been removed. certificate_notification_enabled The certificate expiration notification for an FQDN has been enabled. certificate_notification_disabled The certificate expiration notification for an FQDN has been disabled.

docs.title: Fields
docs.text: Field Value Explanation target String The FQDN that the certificate is issued for. terms_url String The URL of the ACME terms of service accepted at setup. reason String The error returned by the ACME server when the certificate request failed.

docs.title: Events and triggers
docs.text: Event Trigger online_license_imported An online license has been imported. online_license_removed An online license has been removed. offline_license_imported An offline license has been imported. offline_license_removed An offline license has been removed. license_expiration_notification_enabled The license expiration notification has been enabled. license_expiration_notification_disabled The license expiration notification has been disabled.

docs.title: Fields
docs.text: Field Value Explanation license String The masked license key of the online license that has been imported or removed.

docs.title: Events and triggers
docs.text: Event Trigger database_restored The system has been restored from a database backup file. logs_remove The logs up to (and including) a month have been removed. The result is success when all logs have been removed, or failure with extra_result partial failure when some logs could not be removed. inventory_remove The inventories up to (and including) a month have been removed. The result is success when all inventories have been removed, or failure with extra_result partial failure when some could not be removed. patches_remove The patches up to (and including) a month have been removed. The result is success when all patches have been removed, or failure with extra_result partial failure when some could not be removed. centralized_session_recording_storage_path_updated The storage path of the centralized session recording has been updated, by a user or by the system. centralized_session_recording_retention_period_updated The retention period of the centralized session recording has been updated, by a user or by the system.

docs.title: Fields
docs.text: Field Value Explanation target String The name of the backup file that the system has been restored from. Present only in the database_restored event. extra_result partial failure The reason of a failed removal. Present only when the result is failure. removal_up_to String The month (in yyyy-mm format, UTC) up to which the items have been removed. Present only when the result is success. success_count Integer The number of items that have been removed successfully. Present only when the result is failure. failure_count Integer The number of items that could not be removed. Present only when the result is failure. old_path String The previous storage path of the centralized session recording. new_path String The updated storage path of the centralized session recording. old_retention Integer The previous retention period of the centralized session recording, in days. new_retention Integer The updated retention period of the centralized session recording, in days.
